1.title: Ohio Senator Calls Former Son-in-Law Accused of Abuse Unfit for Office
1.summary: Senator Bernie Moreno, Republican of Ohio, broke his silence about allegations of domestic abuse his daughter has made against Representative Max Miller.

2.title: How ransom notes could help catch Nancy Guthrie's kidnapper
2.summary: A forensic linguist told the BBC it's possible to glean crucial information about a person from just a few sentences.

3.title: Hundreds of flights cancelled as workers strike at Canada's WestJet
3.summary: The strike by flight attendants at Canada's second-largest air carrier hits travellers on one of the busiest summer holiday weekends.

4.title: Iran Plotted Wider War With Help of Its Proxies
4.summary: During a fleeting truce, Iranians covertly devised a plan to raise the war’s costs for President Trump if U.S. forces attacked anew.

5.title: Two crew killed as British pilot survives after firefighting helicopters collide in Greece
5.summary: One Danish and one Greek national died in the incident, while a British pilot and another Greek crew member survived.

6.title: Uganda unveils statue of Israel PM's brother who died in Entebbe rescue mission
6.summary: Yonatan Netanyahu was the only Israeli soldier to die as he led a mission to free more than 100 hostages.
